_note: Verified खरीदार (buyers/traders) and इनपुट डीलर shown on /bhav/{crop}/{state}/{district}/kharidar — the page that answers the question every price page leaves hanging: 'भाव तो पता चल गया, अब बेचूं किसे?'. SEED THIS BY HAND, a few districts at a time; it needs no farmers to be useful. An entry renders ONLY when active:true AND it has a name, district and at least one contact number, so a half-filled row can never reach a farmer. A district with zero live entries renders a noindex page — we do not publish empty directory pages (thin/doorway content is exactly how a programmatic surface gets an entire site demoted). Read live by mtime: adding a dealer needs no deploy. commodities:[] means 'buys everything' — otherwise list /bhav crop slugs (wheat, paddy, mustard...). state/district must match the Agmarknet spelling the mandi feed sends, which is what the /bhav URL is built from; matching is case- and space-insensitive. verified:true is a claim WE make — only set it after actually speaking to the person, because the blue-tick promise is the whole product. TRUST RULE, same as lead_offers.json: never publish a number that will not be answered.
